records.Name: JojaCola pricing pressure
records.Description__c: Joja procurement is anchoring on last year's per-seat rate and pushing back on the JojaCola Analytics uplift. Competitive quote from a regional vendor is circulating internally.
records.Mitigation_Plan__c: CFO-level value framing on total cost of ownership; offer a 2-year price lock in exchange for an expanded seat commitment. Lewis Thornton to sponsor internally.
